pages.text: The $(d)Black Death$() Gene $(c)instantly kills whoever has it$().$(br2)Given the strength of this Gene, it's much harder to acquire than the other plagues.

To craft this DNA Helix, you'll have to get a full Syringe that has $(c)$(bold)every other negative Gene$() in the game. This includes all the other plagues, but excludes any disabled Genes.$(br2)From there, simply brew that Syringe into a Potion of Viral Agents.
